description: Adds an entry to your Glazecalc notebook (the Notebook page), with an optional title: a test result, an observation, a firing to try. With about, it is a note about one of your recipes, materials or firing logs, which list_notes finds by that record's id. Needs an access token that can read and change your records.

about.description: The saved record the entry is about, when it is about one: list_notes with its id finds it again.

id.description: Its id, from list_recipes, list_my_materials or list_firings.

kind.description: A recipe, one of your materials, or a firing log.

name: add_notebook_entry
title: Add to my notebook
